environment.description: Application deployed on Apache Tomcat 9.0.65 behind an nginx reverse proxy (proxy_pass only, no filtering). PostgreSQL 14 database with DB_USER having full privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables. No query-level firewall or statement inspection. JVM running with default security manager disabled (-Djava.security.manager=disallow). Network: application server has direct TCP connectivity to database on port 5432.

config.proxy: nginx 1.22 with proxy_pass, no ModSecurity, no request filtering
config.database: PostgreSQL 14, user has GRANT ALL on public schema
